June 6, 2018 - By Pete Kolinski
Rock Springs Capital Management Lp increased its stake in Axogen Inc (AXGN) by 5.76% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rock Springs Capital Management Lp bought 27,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 53.73% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 505,000 shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $18.43M, up from 477,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rock Springs Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Axogen Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.20% or $0.1 $49.85. Sanders Capital Llc increased its stake in Bp Plc (BP) by 64.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sanders Capital Llc bought 2.54M shares as the company’s stock rose 10.08% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6.45M shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $261.57M, up from 3.92M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sanders Capital Llc who had been investing in Bp Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $155.91 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $0.33 $46.29. Sanders Capital Llc, which manages about $15.69B and $19.51 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in D R Horton Inc (NYSE:DHI) by 1.19M shares to 13.89 million shares, valued at $651.74M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg Ltd (NYSE:TSM) by 1.01M shares in the quarter, leaving it with 32.72 million shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Among 30 analysts covering BP ( NYSE:BP ), 22 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 73% are positive. BP had 63 analyst reports since July 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, October 11 by BNP Paribas. The company was maintained on Monday, July 11 by Jefferies. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Friday, July 24 by TheStreet. The firm has “Buy” rating by Credit Agricole given on Tuesday, December 15. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Nomura given on Friday, March 18. As per Tuesday, April 24, the company rating was upgraded by Goldman Sachs. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, June 12 by J.P. Morgan. Macquarie Research upgraded BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) on Thursday, April 26 to “Neutral” rating. Piper Jaffray maintained it with “Buy” rating and $51.0 target in Tuesday, January 23 report. The rating was initiated by BMO Capital Markets with “Outperform” on Monday, September 28.
Among 8 analysts covering AxoGen ( NASDAQ:AXGN ), 8 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 0 Hold. Therefore 100% are positive. AxoGen had 23 analyst reports since August 11, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Outperform” rating by Leerink Swann on Thursday, November 2. The stock of AxoGen, Inc. (NASDAQ:AXGN) earned “Outperform” rating by Wedbush on Friday, August 28. The rating was maintained by Wedbush with “Outperform” on Monday, November 7. Leerink Swann maintained AxoGen, Inc. (NASDAQ:AXGN) on Tuesday, November 21 with “Outperform” rating. Roth Capital maintained AxoGen, Inc. (NASDAQ:AXGN) on Monday, September 11 with “Buy” rating. As per Tuesday, May 1, the company rating was maintained by Cantor Fitzgerald. Lake Street maintained AxoGen, Inc. (NASDAQ:AXGN) rating on Friday, March 2. Lake Street has “Buy” rating and $38.0 target. Wedbush maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, November 21 report. Cantor Fitzgerald maintained AxoGen, Inc. (NASDAQ:AXGN) rating on Monday, January 8. Cantor Fitzgerald has “Buy” rating and $37.0 target. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, August 11 by Zacks.
Rock Springs Capital Management Lp, which manages about $319.00 million and $2.34 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Pra Health Sciences Inc by 82,500 shares to 395,000 shares, valued at $32.77 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Aimmune Therapeutics Inc by 133,000 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 160,000 shares, and cut its stake in Odonate Therapeutics Inc. - Pete Kolinski
